routine_name: 20-Minute Emergency Fake-Clean Protocol Before Guests Arrive
priority_order: Powder room mirror wipe, hand towel swap, soap replenishment (4 mins)
Kitchen sink clear & citrus disposal drop (5 mins)
Main seating area pillow fluff & throw blanket fold (4 mins)
Warm ambient lighting & dim overheads (2 mins)
stress_reduction_impact: Eliminates pre-entertaining host burnout while ensuring pristine public zones

equipment: Repurposed shallow baskets and wall hooks
